name: Nanoscale Engineering
description: Nanomaterial synthesis (chemical synthesis, chemical and physical vapor deposition, mechanical and solution based exfoliation); material characterization (Raman and IR vibrational spectroscopy, scanning electron microscopy, transmission electron microscopy, atomic force microscopy); fabrication of nanoscale devices (photolithography, electron beam lithography, metal and oxide deposition); semiconductor physics (electronic structure, band theory, charge transport); performance of nanoscale devices (field effect transistors, solar cells, field effect mobility, quantum confinement).
